questions.statement: What's the main reason you invested in your blueprint?
What's your current work situation? (employed full-time, freelancing, job searching, building something on the side, etc.). What do you do specifically?
If money and failure weren't factors, what would you spend your working hours doing?
Do you want to start a business? Share details.
Think about the last time you were close to a breakthrough but it fell apart. What happened?
What's a goal you've had for 2+ years that you still haven't achieved? What do you tell yourself about why?
When you imagine yourself succeeding at your biggest goal, what's the first negative thought that shows up?
Who's the one person whose opinion of you matters most professionally? What do you think they currently think of you?

When you need buy-in from someone important, what's your default approach? (Options: over-prepare and present logic / avoid until necessary / charm and read the room / send an email instead of asking in person)
How do you typically respond when you get good advice? (implement immediately / research more first / wait until it feels right / acknowledge it then forget)
What's the last self-improvement book, course, or program you bought? Did you finish it?
